questiontext.text:
Which of the following is NOT a notation used in life table.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

\(nZx,\): there is no such notation in the use of a life table.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

\(_{n}I_{x}\): there is no such notation in the use of a life table, only \(I_{x}\) with "\(n\)" subscript exists.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

\(b_{x}\): there is no such notation in the use of a life table.

[[/ if ]]
